# Manual Testdata

- `perft.tsv`:

    This dataset combines six positions from the
    [Chessprogramming Wiki's Perft Results](
        https://chessprogramming.org/Perft_Results
    ) and 127 positions from
    [Terje Kir's EngineTests perftsuite.epd](
        https://github.com/TerjeKir/EngineTests/blob/master/testfiles/perftsuite.epd
    ).
